import json
from sympy import Rational as Q, expand, symbols
a,b,c=symbols('a b c')
num=lambda a,b,c:b*b+c*c-a*a
assert expand(num(a,b,c)+num(b,a,c)+num(c,a,b)-(a*a+b*b+c*c))==0
mapping=[]
for opposite,b,c in [(5,3,4),(3,4,5),(4,3,5)]:
 n=num(Q(opposite),Q(b),Q(c));co=n/(2*b*c);mapping.append(dict(opposite=opposite,numerator=str(n),cosine=str(co)))
assert [x['numerator'] for x in mapping]==['0','32','18']
assert [x['cosine'] for x in mapping]==['0','4/5','3/5']
beta=Q(1,2);den=1-beta*beta;gamma=(1+beta*beta)/den;off=2*beta/den;trace=2*gamma+2
assert den==Q(3,4) and gamma==Q(5,3) and off==Q(4,3) and trace==Q(16,3)
assert trace!=4 and trace!=Q(7,5)
assert sum(num(Q(x),Q(y),Q(z)) for x,y,z in [(5,3,4),(3,4,5),(4,3,5)])==50
print(json.dumps(dict(polynomial_residual='0',opposite_side_mapping=mapping,numerator_total='50',cosine_sum='7/5',beta=str(beta),denominator=str(den),gamma=str(gamma),off_diagonal=str(off),block_trace=str(trace),trace_minus_four=str(trace-4),trace_minus_cosine_sum=str(trace-Q(7,5)))))
